run_train_net: run the CenterNet2 training script with a config file to train an object detection model
run_do_train: run the do_train function to train a detection model with optimizer, scheduler, and periodic checkpointing
run_do_test: run the do_test function to evaluate a detection model on COCO or LVIS datasets
run_setup: run the setup function to create and freeze a Detectron2 config from a YAML file and CLI options
run_main: run the main function to optionally evaluate or train a CenterNet2 model with distributed GPU support
